The local restore checked 17 tables and six sequence bounds using an isolated temporary dump. Encrypted off-machine backups, host disaster recovery and automatic startup/outage recovery remain unqualified.

Local public-rate/load tests do not qualify Internet capacity. Public TLS, restricted Google imagery credentials and quotas, host maintenance, recovery, shared GOOL capacity and website navigation coordination remain pre-site requirements.
The five-image inventory identifies the candidate. Individual browser, replay and restore checks exercised only their stated roles; the tunnel image was not exercised by the four-hour observers.

The April archive remains preserved separately; quarantined placeholder coordinates were not silently merged into live observations. Historical test results and earlier pending matrix prose retain their original context and do not override the current hash-bound review records.
